evidence_gaps: Fresh-within-two-hours sanitised runtime forensics are unavailable; evidence.json has generated_epoch=0 and evidence_status=MISSING_RUNTIME_FORENSICS.
Per-trade money-weighted realised NET P&L after DEX fees, slippage, price impact, EVM gas/priority fees, Solana priority fees, rent/account costs and failed-attempt costs.
Immutable chain, asset, notional, native currency and reference-value denomination for every outcome.
Non-overlapping out-of-sample windows and deduplicated outcome identifiers.
Contemporaneous signal, quote, simulation, submission, receipt/finality and balance-delta records.
Explicit STRATEGY/MARKET loss versus EXECUTION/INFRASTRUCTURE failure classification, including UNKNOWN cases and classification audit accuracy.
EVM per-chain gas-regime, revert, replacement, MEV/quote-decay and settlement statistics.
Solana dynamic priority-fee, blockhash-expiry, landing/finality, RPC degradation, quote-to-fill decay and executable-exit statistics.
Liquidity depth and sellability evidence at actual position size throughout holding and exit.
Capital exposure over time, money-weighted return, maximum drawdown, tail loss and cost-inclusive profit factor by strategy and chain.
Sufficient independent observations and uncertainty bounds showing positive out-of-sample NET edge after failure costs.

Before any promotion: fresh runtime evidence must demonstrate complete reconciliation, chain-isolated positive money-weighted NET P&L, acceptable drawdown, reliable sellability and simulation, and no unresolved infrastructure failure cluster.

proposals.downside_risk: Stricter reconciliation and non-overlapping observations will reduce apparent sample size and may invalidate historical scorecards.

evidence.detail: record_window accepts an externally supplied net_profit instead of requiring reconciliation to gross profit, gross loss, fees and slippage.
strategy_metrics sums monetary fields across all windows without an explicit chain, asset, currency or capital-weighting dimension.
Profit factor uses gross_profit/gross_loss while the promotion decision separately uses net profit, allowing costs to be omitted from the ratio.

proposals.expected_effect: Chain-specific, cost-complete, auditable NET P&L and drawdown evidence with promotion decisions based on comparable value units and deployed capital.
proposals.minimum_observation: At least 30 independently closed outcomes per strategy and chain across at least 10 non-overlapping market windows, including adverse-liquidity and high-fee periods; assess money-weighted net return, cost-inclusive profit factor and maximum drawdown.
proposals.rationale: Money-weighted promotion evidence must not add SOL, ETH and other native-token amounts as if they shared a unit. It must also prevent inconsistent submitted net values and overlapping windows from overstating results.
proposals.shadow_test: Replay SHADOW observations into per-chain ledgers containing notional, quote timestamp, native and contemporaneous reference-currency values, every explicit cost, and non-overlapping outcome identifiers. Require computed net to equal proceeds minus principal, DEX fees, slippage/impact, gas or priority fees and failed-attempt costs. Stop and reject the ledger on currency mixing, duplicate outcomes, missing costs or any reconciliation mismatch.

proposals.downside_risk: Classification can be wrong when receipts, balance deltas or quote snapshots are absent; such cases must remain UNKNOWN rather than inferred.

evidence.detail: Execution failures are aggregated as a count without cause, attempted notional, failure cost or stage.
Canary processing increments a generic execution_failures counter and pauses after two failures, but does not distinguish RPC, simulation, signing, broadcast, revert, expiry or settlement failures.
A sanitised runtime bridge exists, but evidence.json reports that no current runtime forensics were available.

proposals.expected_effect: Actionable attribution, cost-complete failure accounting and protection against replacing sound signals because of infrastructure faults or retaining bad signals because failures were excluded.
proposals.minimum_observation: At least 100 attempted executions per chain, including at least 20 failures or controlled fault-injection cases spanning stale quotes, RPC errors, simulation rejection, EVM revert/replacement and Solana expiry/finality ambiguity.
proposals.rationale: STRATEGY/MARKET loss means a successfully executable position lost after all costs because the signal or market path was unfavorable. EXECUTION/INFRASTRUCTURE failure means intended execution was not completed or settlement evidence is unreliable. Combining these obscures whether to rework alpha, routing or infrastructure; failed attempts can also consume fees and must affect NET P&L.
proposals.shadow_test: For every attempted SHADOW execution, persist immutable signal, quote, simulation, submission, receipt/finality and balance-delta stages. Classify exactly one of STRATEGY_MARKET_LOSS, EXECUTION_INFRA_FAILURE, SUCCESSFUL_NET_GAIN or UNKNOWN, while charging all observed failed-attempt costs. Manually audit a stratified sample and stop promotion if UNKNOWN exceeds 5% or audited misclassification exceeds 2%.

proposals.downside_risk: More conservative dynamic reserves may eliminate most signals; that is preferable to forcing trades without positive executable edge.

evidence.detail: SHADOW entry and exit network/priority fees use fixed estimates of 0.00002 SOL.
Entry validation uses contemporaneous Jupiter forward and reverse quotes and rejects excessive immediate round-trip loss.
Solana Strategy Lab features deliberately set gross edge, fees, slippage, price impact, liquidity and sellability to zero and mark outcomes unavailable rather than inventing evidence.

proposals.expected_effect: A Solana-specific distribution of realised-equivalent NET outcomes incorporating priority fees, landing failures, latency, route impact and exit liquidity.
proposals.minimum_observation: At least 50 closed SHADOW positions across 20 assets and 14 days, with at least 10 observations during elevated priority fees or degraded RPC conditions and complete executable exit quotes.
proposals.rationale: The fail-closed Strategy Lab behavior should be kept, but fixed priority-fee estimates cannot demonstrate durable executable edge under congestion. Jupiter quote output captures route economics only at observation time and does not establish landing probability, quote-to-fill decay, failed-attempt cost or future exit sellability.
proposals.shadow_test: For each eligible leader event, snapshot forward and unwind quotes, route price impact, account-creation/rent requirements, dynamic priority-fee estimate and simulated landing outcome; re-quote at realistic submission and confirmation delays and mark-to-executable-exit until closure. Charge failed attempts and stop the hypothesis if money-weighted net is non-positive, the lower confidence bound is non-positive, sellability ever becomes unknown, or failure-adjusted edge is exhausted.

proposals.downside_risk: Per-chain segmentation lengthens evaluation and may leave sparse chains dormant.

evidence.detail: EVM cycle simulation reserves estimated gas and requires quoted output to repay capital, gas reserve and configured minimum net profit.
Prebroadcast validation rebuilds and eth_call-simulates the exact transaction before signing.
Canary state is keyed only by strategy, so observations from different EVM chains can share one lifecycle state and native-unit net total.
Promotion uses small aggregate trade-count and profit-factor thresholds without chain isolation or uncertainty bounds.

proposals.expected_effect: Prevents a favorable low-cost chain from masking negative economics or failures on another EVM chain and makes promotion evidence money-weighted and chain-specific.
proposals.minimum_observation: At least 50 closed or terminal attempts per strategy per EVM chain over 14 days and multiple gas regimes, with no mixed-native-unit aggregation and at least 95% complete receipt/balance-delta reconciliation.
proposals.rationale: The EVM prebroadcast protections are worth keeping, but chain-specific gas markets, native-token values, block times, MEV exposure and failure rates require separate evidence. Eight favorable small observations are not durable evidence by themselves.
proposals.shadow_test: Run identical route hypotheses separately by chain using exact prebroadcast simulations followed by delayed re-quotes and receipt-equivalent outcome tracking. Include EIP-1559 priority cost, approval/amortized setup cost, revert/replacement cost, price impact, slippage and quote decay. Stop a chain cohort when cumulative money-weighted net is non-positive after the minimum sample, failure cost exceeds gross edge, or the lower confidence bound crosses zero.

rejected_ideas.idea: Promote any strategy because its quote-simulated net edge is positive.
rejected_ideas.reason: Quote simulations are explicitly non-promotional and do not establish fills, exit sellability, failed-attempt costs or out-of-sample NET P&L.

rejected_ideas.idea: Increase trade frequency or relax filters to satisfy participation thresholds.
rejected_ideas.reason: No trade should be manufactured without positive executable edge; low activity is acceptable when eligible opportunities are absent.

rejected_ideas.idea: Rank or retain strategies primarily by win rate.
rejected_ideas.reason: Win count ignores loss magnitude, capital weighting and total execution costs.

rejected_ideas.idea: Treat missing runtime forensics as proof of strategy or infrastructure failure.
rejected_ideas.reason: It prohibits readiness and profitability claims but does not itself establish either loss category.

summary: Architecture-only review completed. The repository has useful fail-closed quote, simulation, liquidity and sellability controls, and Solana Strategy Lab inputs correctly refuse to invent executable edge. However, lifecycle accounting can aggregate incomparable native currencies, accept caller-supplied net P&L without reconciliation, and calculate profit factor before costs. Execution failures are counted separately but not sufficiently classified from STRATEGY/MARKET losses. No profitability, CANARY-readiness or LIVE-readiness conclusion is possible without fresh runtime forensics.
